Vercel 宣布 skills.sh API 现已上线。开发者使用 Vercel OIDC token 认证，即可查询开源生态中超 60 万 个 skills 的详情与安全审计。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

Cursor 更新 Design Mode ，允许开发者在内置浏览器中通过点击、绘制或语音提示修改 UI，并交由 Agent 直接编辑底层源代码。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

阿里巴巴 近期在 GitHub 开源了其内部 AI 代码审查工具 Open Code Review ，采用确定性工程管线与 LLM Agent 混合架构，兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic API 。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"text","text":"Google 推出面向企业的 Agentic RAG 框架"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
Google Research 与 Google Cloud 联合推出全新的 Agentic RAG 框架，该系统采用多智能体架构，通过核心的 Sufficient Context Agent 评估上下文完整性并触发迭代检索，官方称其比标准 RAG 准确率最高提升 34% 。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"text","text":"腾讯混元与人大团队开源 PlanningBench 规划基准"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
腾讯混元 与 人大 团队开源 PlanningBench 基准，用于大模型复杂规划任务的评估与训练，现已发布 467 个合成评估实例。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/PlanningBench","text":"https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/PlanningBench"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"16. "},{"tag":"text","text":"通义实验室开源通用智能体评测基准 PawBench"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
通义实验室 推出并开源评测基准 PawBench 。该基准面向通用智能体，通过 150 道任务评测底座模型与运行框架的联合效果，帮助开发者精准定位问题。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"text","text":"Anthropic 发表白皮书：Claude Opus 4.7 在 NMR 光谱预测中比肩专业软件"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

据报道，随着 AI 智能体导致 Token 消耗剧增，多家科技企业因预算失控开始限制内部 AI 支出。 Linux Foundation 宣布成立 Tokenomics Foundation 旨在制定计费标准。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"text","text":"基于阿里千问微调，NBA官方大模型“NBA Chat”上线"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
NBA中国与 阿里 联合打造的首个官方大模型 NBA Chat 正式上线，球迷现可在官方APP内体验基于 千问 大模型的智能篮球问答服务。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

{"title":"Daily AI Info (2/2)","elements":[[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
媒体报道称 Meta 将在 路易斯安那州 建设投资额达 2000 亿美元 的数据中心。另有消息称，为维持 AI 支出，该公司正考虑发售数百亿美元新股。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-06-05/the-200-billion-data-center-transforming-louisiana-video","text":"https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-06-05/the-200-billion-data-center-transforming-louisiana-video"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Paper"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"1. "},{"tag":"text","text":"You Only Index Once: Cross-Layer Sparse Attention with Shared Routing"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-06-04"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
该论文提出跨层稀疏注意力（CLSA），在YOCO等KV共享架构中，单个索引器一次计算token级top-k选择并跨解码层共享，在128K上下文下实现7.6倍解码加速和17.1倍吞吐提升，兼顾准确性与效率，为长上下文LLM提供完整架构方案。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06467","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06467"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"2. "},{"tag":"text","text":"More than a Judge: An Empirical Study of Agent-Human Interaction in Crowdsourced Testing Assessment"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-06-04"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
通过20名测试者在三个真实应用上的四阶段受控实验，发现多智能体评估系统生成的反馈不仅改善即时报告修订，还提升新任务首次提交质量和跨应用实践迁移，结合事后问卷证实反馈被理解、采纳并延续，表明评估智能体可成为上游报告质量改进的工作流集成反馈提供者。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06301","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06301"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"3. "},{"tag":"text","text":"Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-06-04"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
SARDI框架利用扩散语言模型去噪过程中丢弃的低置信度令牌作为前瞻信号，在生成过程中动态触发检索以获取更强证据，无需训练且与检索器无关，在五个多跳问答基准上以最高8倍吞吐量超越现有训练无关的扩散和自回归检索基线。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06474","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06474"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"4. "},{"tag":"text","text":"Scaffold, Not Vocabulary? A Controlled, Two-Tier, Pre-Registered Study of a Popperian Code-Generation Skill"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-06-04"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
通过预注册的双模型消融实验，对比完整波普尔式技能、纯标签框架、长度匹配安慰剂与执行神谕，发现大型模型因天花板效应未显示增益，小型模型的结构化提示提升20-22个点的执行正确率但程序内容无额外收益，表明收益归因于框架结构，提供校准性负面结果及可复用的提示技能评估协议。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06454","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06454"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"5. "},{"tag":"text","text":"PAMF: Prior-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Incomplete Time Series Data"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-06-04"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
该论文提出PAMF框架，针对多模态时间序列中的单一模态内缺失和整个模态缺失，使用先验感知的流匹配与权重共享编码器连接填补与分类，在多个医疗时间序列基准上取得最优下游性能，为不完整数据的融合提供了新方案。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06328","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06328"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"6. "},{"tag":"text","text":"Unsupervised Skill Discovery for Agentic Data Analysis"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

DataCOPE提出无监督技能发现框架，通过自适应检查表验证器与答案一致性验证器从探索轨迹中提取信号，迭代蒸馏可复用数据分析技能，在报告和分析任务上平均提升9.71%和32.30%。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"text","text":"SoCRATES: Towards Reliable Automated Evaluation of Proactive LLM Mediation across Domains and Socio-cognitive Variations"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05563","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05563"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"8. 2026-06-05"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
